svg.text: One conflation lens per Monster irrep — the 194 supersingular signatures
each of the Monster's 194 irreps → one lens conflating its prime-power towers pᵉ as base-p space-filling curves (2 Hilbert · rest Peano)
within every lens the towers are screen-blended · spun at their own rate (interference) · pulsed to cohere ⇄ decohere; grid ordered by decreasing Σeₚ
colours — 2 cyan · 3 magenta · 5 amber · 7 green · 11 orange · 13 violet · 17 teal · 19 red · 23 blue · 29 lime · 31 pink · 41 mint · 47 tan · 59 indigo · 71 white
every drawn vertex is a genuine Hilbert/Peano output; each pᵉ shown at its smallest base-p square, down-sampled to a drawable layer
